headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera hit two home runs and drove in three runs in just three at-bats. The New York Yankees also secured a win, taking down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1 behind Paul Goldschmidt's 9th home run of the season. The San Diego Padres had a successful day, taking down the Baltimore Orioles twice, first 9-3 and then 5-2.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Michael Helman of the Texas Rangers, who was placed on the 10-day injured list. The San Francisco Giants also placed Keaton Winn on the 15-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Freddy Fermin of the San Diego Padres was placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, while José Ramírez of the Cleveland Guardians and Vinnie Pasquantino of the Kansas City Royals were both placed on the 10-day injured list due to separate injuries.

The Chicago White Sox made a pair of trades, acquiring Nolan Jones and cash from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for Future Considerations. The White Sox also traded RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. The Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera hit two home runs and drove in three runs in just three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Paul Goldschmidt leading the offense. Goldschmidt hit his 9th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored Cody Bellinger.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Vásquez earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 2 ER, and 2 BB. Samad Taylor led the Padres' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Nationals Cruise Past Mariners 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a decisive 8-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Cade Cavalli earning the win. Colt Emerson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates in their recent matchup. Impact players for the Marlins included Liam Hicks and Heriberto Hernández, while Max Meyer and Paul Skenes stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Fernando Tatis Jr. and Jackson Merrill contributing to the winning effort.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Michael Helman Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Michael Helman has been placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
